title: BuggyMLE: Scaling Machine Learning Engineering Difficulty with Bug Injection
abstract: arXiv:2611.25088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enabling AI systems to autonomously improve AI models requires agents capable of performing machine learning engineering (MLE). In practice, designing, training, and evaluating complex models demands modifying multi-file repositories to reproduce results, debug training runs, integrate datasets, and port frameworks. However, existing MLE benchmarks limit agents to single-file edits without full repository or shell access, and common repository-level software engineering benchmarks have rapidly saturated. To address this, we introduce the Code Complexity Index (CCI), a difficulty metric based on ten structural features spanning repository scale, dependency depth, and patch size. CCI strongly predicts average solve rates across eight public coding benchmarks ($R^2 = 0.951$), identifying patch size and complexity as top predictors. Guided by CCI, we develop BuggyMLE, a scalable framework where agents inject controlled mutations into working

translated_title: BuggyMLE：通过错误注入扩展机器学习工程难度
translated_abstract: 让AI系统能够自主改进AI模型，需要具备执行机器学习工程（MLE）能力的智能体。在实践中，设计、训练和评估复杂模型需要修改多文件代码库，以复现结果、调试训练过程、整合数据集以及移植框架。然而，现有的MLE基准测试将智能体限制为仅能进行单文件编辑，且无法完整访问代码库或shell，而常见的代码库级软件工程基准测试已迅速饱和。为解决这一问题，我们提出了代码复杂度指数（CCI），这是一种基于十个结构特征的难度度量指标，涵盖代码库规模、依赖深度和补丁大小。CCI在八个公开编码基准测试中能够有力预测平均解决率（R²=0.951），并确定补丁大小和复杂度是最主要的预测因素。在CCI的指导下，我们开发了BuggyMLE，这是一个可扩展的框架，智能体在其中向正常工作的代码注入受控的变异错误（注：原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出基于十个结构特征的代码复杂度指数（CCI）来有效预测编码基准的任务难度（R²=0.951），并据此构建了BuggyMLE框架，通过向可运行的代码库注入受控错误来规模化提升机器学习工程任务的难度。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Code Complexity Index (CCI), a difficulty metric based on ten structural features that strongly predicts solve rates across eight coding benchmarks (R²=0.951), and uses it to develop BuggyMLE, a scalable framework that scales machine learning engineering difficulty by injecting controlled bugs into working code repositories.
